description: For an existing deposit booking on your signed-in Direct account, reconcile its Stripe Checkout payment and return its receipt and separate booking state. Requires direct:tasks. Uses only the stored merchant account and amount; creates no new charge or booking identity. A verified paid checkout may finish its already-authorized held booking. Payout status remains unknown; paid does not mean a bank payout. The human pays on Stripe’s hosted page.
name: get_direct_payment
title: Check your merchant checkout and booking
